title: AlexU-AIC at Arabic Hate Speech 2022: Contrast to Classify
findings: The paper found that detecting religious hate speech was particularly challenging due to extreme data imbalance. The 'Religion' category was noted as having very few samples, with one part of the paper stating it wasn't present at all in the training data, leading to low model performance on the fine-grained classification task (sub-task C).
